name: BD (Becton Dickinson)
description: BD makes syringes, needles, IV catheters, infusion pumps and dispensing automation, prefillable drug-delivery syringes, and surgical, urology and peripheral-vascular products, selling mostly to hospitals, labs and drugmakers. Revenue is razor-and-blade: a capital item (infusion pump, dispensing cabinet) is installed and the consumables (IV sets, catheters, syringes) are bought repeatedly; BD cites about $2.0 billion of unsatisfied minimum-purchase commitments on consumables. On 2026-02-09 it spun its Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business into Waters Corporation (a Reverse Morris Trust); the FY2025 10-K figures below still include it, while 2026 quarters show four continuing segments.

employees.note: approximately 72,000 associates in 61 countries (before the Waters spin-off)

businessLines.name: Medical (now Medical Essentials, Connected Care and BioPharma Systems)
businessLines.how: Sells vascular access, syringes and needles, infusion pumps and dispensing systems, and prefillable syringes to hospitals and drugmakers; pumps and cabinets are capital, with consumables bought repeatedly.

businessLines.name: Life Sciences (Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions spun to Waters 2026-02-09; Specimen Management stayed in Medical Essentials)
businessLines.how: Sells blood-collection and specimen tubes (recurring consumables), and instruments plus reagents for infectious-disease testing and flow cytometry to labs and hospitals.

businessLines.name: Interventional
businessLines.how: Sells surgical hernia and soft-tissue products, peripheral-vascular intervention devices and urology and critical-care products (catheters, temperature management) to hospitals, per procedure and as repeat disposables.

brands.name: Alaris infusion pumps
brands.note: made by CareFusion 303; operating under an amended FDA consent decree (see issues); no revenue disclosed

brands.name: Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions (spun to Waters Corporation)
brands.note: Completed 2026-02-09 via Reverse Morris Trust; BD used cash proceeds for an accelerated share repurchase and $2 billion of debt repayment.
